video_title: Lakers’ Defensive Issues // Grizzlies’ Hot Start // Heat Are Winning | Chris Mannix & Evan Turner

quotes.speaker: Evan Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's importance to the Mavericks' success
quotes.excerpt: It comes down to can he do it, is his availability going to be there when it comes down to May.
quotes.quote: To be compared to San Antonio, you have to be literally elite, or you are going to have to have that one X-factor that can send you over the top, which they do with Luka Doncic. It comes down to can he do it, is his availability going to be there when it comes down to May.

quotes.speaker: Evan Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Mavericks need to rely on identity, not just special moments
quotes.excerpt: You have to stop relying on the special stuff and you have to rely on what your identity is going to be.
quotes.quote: You have to stop relying on the special stuff and you have to rely on what your identity is going to be. If they can sustain this high-scoring, high-run pace, God bless them, or forcing so many turnovers. You might not get a steal into an easy two points versus better teams, you are going to have to get a stop. You are not going to be able to turn them over or play at a fast pace. It is when you get to these points of playing versus great teams, they are going to be able to dictate what they want to do at a high-high level.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' reliance on Walker Kessler and Anthony Davis
quotes.excerpt: If Anthony Davis goes down in Boston, they're screwed. Cade Cunningham in Detroit, Karl-Anthony Towns in New York.
quotes.quote: If Anthony Davis goes down in Boston, they're screwed. Cade Cunningham in Detroit, Karl-Anthony Towns in New York. I do think you can say that about a lot of teams in the NBA. The Lakers' offense has been really impressive. They are number two in the NBA in scoring. They are first in a bunch of categories, first in field goal percentage, true shooting percentage, effective field goal percentage. They are high-level. Walker Kessler, when he is not playing against the Jazz, has been really good.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' defensive concerns and bench production
quotes.excerpt: They are a very opportunistic defense. They are among the top five teams in steals, blocks, deflections.
quotes.quote: They are a very opportunistic defense. They are among the top five teams in steals, blocks, deflections. They play their passing games extremely well. But defensive rating, they are in the bottom half of the NBA. Same thing with points allowed per game. They turn the ball over a lot, bottom ten in the league in turnovers, and the bench doesn't produce all that much. Walker Kessler has been pretty healthy for most of the season, but he has been injured in the past, most recently, most of last season. If he goes out, he is just as irreplaceable to me as Luka Doncic.

quotes.speaker: Evan Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: High-salary players leave little room for error
quotes.excerpt: Sometimes when you have such high players or you are paying so much, it leaves so little room for errors.
quotes.quote: Sometimes when you have such high players or you are paying so much, it leaves so little room for errors. You get a Walker Kessler, it is like, hey, you don't have two Walker Kesslers on that team. And even when you talk about Walker Kessler on the defensive end, he is the reason why their offense is so great. Him just running, him just getting that pace and just getting to the rack and making himself available, it starts everything else.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' schedule strength and upcoming challenges
quotes.excerpt: They haven't played the best teams in the conference yet.
quotes.quote: They haven't played the best teams in the conference yet. And I know there is some sensitivity in LA about criticisms of their schedule. They don't make the schedule, you play the teams that are put in front of you. They have played two games against Utah with one to go. They played Charlotte, they played Phoenix, they played Milwaukee, Sacramento, they are going to get twice after Friday night, Golden State. The Clippers twice. It is a very soft schedule up until this point.

quotes.speaker: Evan Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Grizzlies' team chemistry and role acceptance
quotes.excerpt: What you can tell about a team with chemistry is how well they accept the role.
quotes.quote: What you can tell about a team with chemistry is how well they accept the role and everybody knows who they are. And that's what I give them far more credit for is just being like, hey, they got half the battle down. It's kind of like with the Blazers. We might not be talented enough, but we got our shit together to win. I think in the NBA, that's half the battle and then we forget, you know, when Luka Doncic wants to win, he figured out how to win.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Grizzlies' roster depth and performance
quotes.excerpt: Cam Boozer is high-level. Ty Jerome, Ty Jerome's an All-Star right now.
quotes.quote: Cam Boozer is high-level. Ty Jerome, Ty Jerome's an All-Star right now. He's an All-Star, full stop. He's an All-Star at the, if you were making a first-month All-Star team, Ty Jerome is on it. The coaching staff is using all of its depth. They're playing a whole bunch of guys out there. The defense has not been bad. They're top ten in defensive rating. So they've been, not as good defensively as they have been offensively, but they've been pretty good.

quotes.speaker: Evan Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Boozer's advanced playmaking and basketball IQ
quotes.excerpt: Cam Boozer, he's playing far beyond his years.
quotes.quote: Cam Boozer, he's playing far beyond his years. So not only is this a good playmaker, a good passer, a solid scorer, but he reads the game so efficiently. You look at Cedric Coward, there's a discussion on, is this a role player, is this a budding star? Regardless, he's got this type of frame, dimensions to really have something to hang your hat on.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Grizzlies' depth and rotation strategy
quotes.excerpt: They've got 15 guys averaging 10 or more minutes per game.
quotes.quote: They've got 15 guys averaging 10 or more minutes per game. Nobody is playing more than 31 minutes per game. And look, when I talk about these 15 guys, only Scotty Pippen Jr. has played five or less games. Everybody else is above nine games. Everybody else has played more than half the season on this team. 15 guys averaging more than 10 minutes per game. Like, they've taken some heat for how they've, like, deconstructed the roster, and it's been painful over the years.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Grizzlies' roster construction and playing style
quotes.excerpt: They did that to create a roster that was built for the Ime Udoka style of play.
quotes.quote: They did that to create a roster that was built for the Ime Udoka style of play. Like, this guy comes from that European culture. He wants to play a whole bunch of guys. He wants to play a free-flowing offense. He wants the ball to move, and they are playing that way. Like, I didn't know what to make of Ime Udoka early in his career. I kind of thought maybe they took a flyer on a guy that was like, really good overseas, but not built for the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Heat's offensive and defensive improvement
quotes.excerpt: They've diversified their offense, which I think has unlocked some stuff in Bam Adebayo.
quotes.quote: They've diversified their offense, which I think has unlocked some stuff in Bam Adebayo, who had a great game, 37 against Cleveland. Clay Thompson has been outstanding during this stretch. Janis continues to be Janis. Davion Mitchell proving everybody wrong. Anybody that thought Davion Mitchell could not be a starting point guard in the NBA, including me, I was one of them, proving people wrong. Are you buying the Heat now?

quotes.speaker: Evan Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Heat's turnaround and team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: I'm buying the Heat now due to the simple fact of the others.
quotes.quote: I'm buying the Heat now due to the simple fact of the others. When we first started the season, everybody, it looked like it was just a one-man show. Obviously, Bam Adebayo was nowhere to be found, Clay was still trying to find his shot, Wiggins was still kind of on chill mode, and you kind of only had Davion Mitchell really showing up. And you know, obviously, Cam Boozer would hit his shots as well. But now it seems as though everybody's stepping up, everybody's in a groove and they have a rhythm.

quotes.speaker: Evan Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Davion Mitchell's impact on team defense and playmaking
quotes.excerpt: Davion Mitchell, even when it comes down to being able to guard Fred VanVleet, he was able.
quotes.quote: Davion Mitchell, even when it comes down to being able to guard Fred VanVleet, he was able to disrupt some of their, their emotional leaders. Like, do you understand what I'm saying? He was able to speed up, be like, yo, if I, if I hit you right here, a gut punch, I, I know you guys are going to crack. And, um, it's almost like Marcus Smart. If he, if he gets going, he has an intangible.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Davion Mitchell's development as a starting point guard
quotes.excerpt: For a long time, Mitchell was like the guy you referenced when there was a college player.
quotes.quote: For a long time, Mitchell was like the guy you referenced when there was a college player coming out who was a little bit undersized. You said, well, he can make it because he's a Davion Mitchell type, which is really like a defensive bulldog who could be kind of a tweener in that backcourt, overcome a size disadvantage. Not many people believed, you know, for years that Davion Mitchell could be a starting point guard, but I was watching that Houston game because I said on Monday morning that like, if they beat the Rockets, I'll be impressed by the Heat.

quotes.speaker: Evan Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Bam Adebayo's improved comfort in the offense
quotes.excerpt: Bam Adebayo, after looking lost in this offense for the first couple of weeks, has looked.
quotes.quote: Bam Adebayo, after looking lost in this offense for the first couple of weeks, has looked a lot more comfortable. Wiggins, they moved to the bench, he's not playing all that well, but you know, Thompson, big-time shot-maker. They're dominating the possession battle in these games. Their defensive rebounding percentage has been great. Their offensive rebounding numbers are good. The defense continues to, to get better.

quotes.speaker: Evan Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Davion Mitchell's elite playmaking and shooting
quotes.excerpt: He's lead the league in assists, bro. To take out, like, to be lead in ahead of Trae.
quotes.quote: He's lead the league in assists, bro. To take out, like, to be lead in ahead of Trae Young in assists is crazy. He's shooting career best from the field at 51% and from three-point range at almost 44%. Now, there's no, any, he leads the NBA in assists right now. There's no way these numbers are sustainable, the shooting numbers, like he's not going to shoot 44% from three, but last season, with a smaller sample size, only averaged about three, three and a half threes per game, he was shooting close to 40%.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Davion Mitchell's career-best shooting and playmaking
quotes.excerpt: He's shooting career best from the field at 51% and from three-point range at almost 44%.
quotes.quote: He's shooting career best from the field at 51% and from three-point range at almost 44%. Now, there's no, any, he leads the NBA in assists right now. There's no way these numbers are sustainable, the shooting numbers, like he's not going to shoot 44% from three, but last season, with a smaller sample size, only averaged about three, three and a half threes per game, he was shooting close to 40%. So this has been coming for Davion Mitchell.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Jayson Tatum and Paul Pierce as scorers
quotes.excerpt: I think Tatum has a case to be made that he is a better scorer than Pierce.
quotes.quote: I think the better conversation is like, who's the better scorer? I remember Tommy Heinsohn once said that Pierce was the greatest scorer in Celtics history. I think Tatum has a case to be made that he is a better scorer than Pierce. But Pierce, you got to done a lot of playoff games, man, in a different era, you know.

quotes.speaker: Evan Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce's scoring ability and playoff performance
quotes.excerpt: When you sit back, bro, and you sit there, you're like, whoa, whoa, whoa, if I break it down.
quotes.quote: When you sit back, bro, and you sit there, you're like, whoa, whoa, whoa, if I break it down, like, Pierce is the truth, bro. Even Andy was like, yo, if he played now, he'd be, he'd be shooting 12 threes a night. He was averaging 28 then. He's like, he'd be, he'd be child's play right now for Paul.
